notes: Full RefSeq assembly includes primary, alternate, patch and non-nuclear sequences. Hits on alternative representations are not automatically distinct biological off-target loci.
Transcripts are the assembly-associated RefSeq RNA set, not all-species refseq_rna and not a single representative isoform per gene.
NCBI may replace files at these URLs; pinned checksum mismatch must fail, never silently update.
Public reference data from NCBI RefSeq/Genome Reference Consortium; retain original headers and assembly/annotation provenance. No private query sequences are downloaded or uploaded.
